reviewer: Independent requirements/evidence reviewer, separate from parent execution and supplementary test author

method.classification: Static dry registration; not execution of case callbacks or acceptance tests
method.runtime: Node vm.runInNewContext, bounded to 1000 milliseconds per source file
procedure: Read the approved machine inventory and select its X0-C, FN-1 and B1 entries.
Read each of the three task test sources and remove import declarations only in an in-memory copy.
Evaluate the in-memory source with describe invoking registration callbacks, it recording titles only, and it.todo recording deferred titles; never invoke a registered test body.
Provide inert PACKAGE.fold and PACKAGE.board values for top-level declarations; do not import test helpers, product modules or installed SDKs.
Derive each case ID from the first space-delimited token in its registered full title; compare ID sets, uniqueness, task ownership, complete title strings and TODO booleans to the approved inventory.
Assert no it.skip registration is present in the selected source files.
Separately verify the new initial plan ledger has all approved IDs, tasks, techniques, complete titles and original approval states intact, with every current ledger status Not Run.
notPerformed: No test body or product/SDK import executed by this audit
No task suite, fixture HTTP server, DSH process, model turn or browser launched
No product, test or harness source changed
No dependency installation, remote operation, credential or .npmrc access
method.persistence: This file records the already completed audit result; creating it did not rerun the audit or any tests.

limitations: Executable means a registered non-TODO case body, not an observed pass.
This audit does not certify the in-progress parent-owned timestamp-reverification task TAP or final per-case results.
All 22 approved TODOs remain unproved acceptance obligations, not passes or waivers.
Supplementary Cordis and detached Session checks are separate from the 137 approved case IDs; two SDK executions do not double the unique inventory.
No completed-X0-C, UI, real model-loop, profile-loader, persistence/restart/recovery or exactly-once real-wake readiness follows from dry registration.
conclusion: PASS: all 137 unique approved IDs, task ownership, complete titles and 22 TODO states are preserved exactly; zero missing, extra, duplicate, removed or promoted cases.
